title: Payment result
note: Check your payment status and view your ticket once your booking is confirmed.
chooseBooking: Open the booking you just paid for to check its latest status and view your ticket after confirmation.

paid.title: Payment confirmed. Your booking is confirmed.

processing.title: We are checking your payment
processing.note: Do not pay again or create another booking for these seats. This page refreshes automatically while verification is pending.

waiting.title: Payment has not been confirmed
waiting.note: Complete payment within the reservation deadline. If you already paid, refresh the status and wait for server confirmation.

failed.title: Payment was unsuccessful
failed.note: This attempt did not complete successfully. Check the latest status before making another reservation.

expired.title: The reservation expired
expired.note: This reservation can no longer be paid. Search again and choose currently available seats.

review.title: Payment needs review
review.note: Keep your booking reference. Do not repeat payment; no ticket is available until the booking is confirmed.

refundRequired.title: Payment cannot confirm this booking
refundRequired.note: A full refund is due. Keep your booking reference and follow the refund status here.

refunded.title: Full refund confirmed
refunded.note: This booking does not have a valid ticket. The time to reach your account depends on the payment provider and bank.

cancelled.title: The operator cancelled this trip
cancelled.note: The ticket is no longer valid. Any full refund due is shown separately below.

checkingNote: We are checking your booking payment. The result will appear here automatically once confirmed.
checkingSafety: Please do not pay again while we check.
